name: unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self
rule: For Rc::<T>::from_raw(ptr) to be safe, if the U in the originating Rc::<U>::into_raw call is sized, U must have the same size and alignment as T.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > alloc::rc::Rc < T > { unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self }
expression: This requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL because the originating type U and its sizedness, size, and alignment are unavailable.
